name: Permanent LINE contract entry and final PDF
type: AM Platform / Engineering contracts / permanent group access
scope: Keep the original LINE invitation usable as a read-only contract entry after submission
Switch the same entry to the final signed PDF after completion
Revalidate LIFF identity and current exact-group membership on every open and PDF request
Remove all signing capabilities from completed-contract access
Verify final artifact privacy, relationship, completion record and SHA-256 before serving
Keep revoked links and expired incomplete sessions blocked

dataIsolation.guard: The opaque token is never logged or returned by APIs. Token possession alone is insufficient; the server revalidates LIFF identity and current membership in the exact bound LINE group before every document response.

definitionOfDone: A completed invitation remains readable after the original signing TTL
The open response is final_contract_read_only with no Party A or Party B signing capability
The document endpoint returns the verified final signed PDF instead of the issued PDF
No signer-open evidence is appended by completed read-only views
Cross-group, removed-member, revoked, non-completed expired, public-artifact and hash-mismatch access is rejected
The Engineering production Render service is Live and the original completed-contract LINE link is verified read-only
